rules.ruby_api_liveness: Every VALUE live across an allocating Ruby C API call must be stack-visible or registered as a movable GC root.
rules.owned_cleanup: Every owned allocation must move to an owner or enter an idempotent ensure cleanup before a raising call.
rules.dominance: A class refinement is usable only in the guard's dominated control-flow region.
rules.invalidation: A callback, generic Ruby invocation, or mutation invalidates accepted-subclass and union refinements unless its intrinsic explicitly preserves them.
rules.exactness: Exact built-in and accepted-subclass refinements are distinct and cannot be substituted.
rules.exception_regions: Ruby ensure and rescue regions lower to explicit protected bodies and idempotent cleanup regions before C emission.
rules.iterators: Blocks and iterators lower to named callback regions; captured values are explicit region inputs.
rules.manifest_only: Lifetime guards, typed-data access, class refinements, and generic-call classifications can only originate in intrinsic manifests.
